messages:
leo (Support): Heads up — I just tried to grant a free trial credit to a customer via the admin console. UI showed the success toast but the ledger has no entry and the customer still sees no credit. Customer is urgent.
maria (Support Lead): link and customer id?
leo (Support): customer: acct_8f3b, console link: https://console.redwood.ai/support/grants/acct_8f3b — repro steps below. I did: open user -> Grants -> amount $200 -> click Submit -> spinner for ~8s -> green toast 'Grant queued' -> nothing in ledger. Support ticket #9872.
support-bot: deploy:service/backoffice v2.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-17T09:20:11Z
jay (SRE): can you grab the browser network logs and the admin-tool server logs around 2026-03-17T09:21? suspect async worker error.
leo (Support): pasted a snippet from admin-tool log:
```
2026-03-17T09:21:14Z INFO POST /api/v1/grants 202 "idempotency=abc123"
2026-03-17T09:21:15Z INFO enqueued job grant:acct_8f3b id=job_778
2026-03-17T09:21:23Z ERROR grant-worker job_778 failed: 502 Bad Gateway from billing-service /ledger/credits
stack: HTTP 502 BadGateway
```
alex (Payments): 502 from billing-service — looks like the billing API returned a transient error during the async commit. Does the grant-worker retry? job metadata?
sarah (Eng): grant-worker should have retries with exponential backoff. If the UI shows toast 'queued' we treat as accepted and job should reconcile. If 502 is during final commit and we don't mark tombstone, you can get toast without ledger write.
jay (SRE): checking the worker queue: there are a few failures in the same window for grants. Found this in worker metrics:
```
grant_worker.failure_rate spike at 2026-03-17T09:20-09:25
error: upstream billing-service 502 (connection reset) x 6
```
maria (Support Lead): customer is on a trial onboarding flow and this blocks signup. Can we do a manual ledger fix and then follow up with root cause? Need an ETA.
alex (Payments): manual fix is possible but must use the internal ledger CLI to avoid double-credit. Run with idempotency key = `abc123` (from admin-tool log) — if job later retries we must be idempotent. I'll handle ledger insert if you confirm.
leo (Support): confirmed idempotency `abc123`. Please go ahead, alex. Also customer wants confirmation email.
alex (Payments): doing manual insert now, will also add a tombstone record: `INSERT INTO grants ... idempotency_key=abc123` — will DM audit link when done.
sarah (Eng): longer term: two asks — 1) ensure worker persists tombstone when final commit fails so UI-success can't be shown without ledger or tombstone, 2) add a retry/alert path when billing-service 5xx rate crosses threshold so SRE/Payments get auto-paged. I can open a tracking PR+issue.
jay (SRE): agree. Also we should have had a circuit-breaker on billing-service so we degrade gracefully and surface a clear UI error instead of success toast.
leo (Support): thanks. Quick repro steps I used (so Eng can reproduce):
1) Admin console -> Grants -> amount $200
2) Submit with network throttling (2s latency) or simulate billing-service 502 via staging proxy
3) Check admin-tool logs for `enqueued job` and worker logs for `502 Bad Gateway`

maria (Support Lead): alex — any ETA on manual ledger audit link?
alex (Payments): done. ledger entry created and tombstone recorded. Audit: https://internal.redwood/ledger/audit/entry/ldg_5521 — customer notified.
leo (Support): customer confirmed credit applied, signup completed. :tada:
sarah (Eng): created issue INF-3421 to persist tombstones and surface non-finalized grants in console; assigning to eng-runtime. I'll include the repro snippet and logs. ETA: PR by end of week.
jay (SRE): added an alert on billing-service 502 surge to our oncall rotation. :eyes:
maria (Support Lead): great work team. Please post the postmortem in #incidents once done so CS has the RCA for the customer.
support-bot: ticket #9872 updated: status -> resolved (manual credit applied)
leo (Support): marking thread resolved. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
